beats.say: Hammerspoon, the power-user automation tool for macOS, has released the first beta of version 2, a ground-up rewrite.
You now script it in JavaScript on JavaScriptCore, the same engine Safari uses, to control windows, hotkeys, screens, audio, Wi-Fi, Shortcuts and more.
It needs macOS 27, installs as a separate app with its own config so Hammerspoon 1 can stay, and ships getting-started and migration guides.
